title: Kenworth T409 SAR FUPS Bullbar #37
description: T409 SAR Kenworth hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Features flush mounted box uprights to suit long dimension configuration. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Provision for Road Train signs. Contoured main bar. Combination indicator and daylight running lights in outer uprights. Driving light mounts to top bar.
